title: A cell discharged, then left to rest
shows: A cell discharged at 0.1 A for 15 minutes delivers exactly 0.025 Ah; left to rest for two hours, its voltage climbs back as the concentrations inside it even out, and settles.
source: Charge conservation and the relaxation of a lithium-ion cell's overpotentials: M. Doyle, T. F. Fuller and J. Newman, J. Electrochem. Soc. 140 (1993) 1526; S. G. Marquis et al., J. Electrochem. Soc. 166 (2019) A3693 (the single-particle model with electrolyte).

checks.what: recovery in the rest's last half hour (V): it has settled
recovery over the whole rest (V): the voltage comes back up
